summary: This directory is responsible for the static analysis of TypeScript class definitions. It processes various class-level constructs including member properties, methods, accessors, and constructors to extract structured metadata, visibility modifiers, and documentation for further application use.
responsibilities: Extract metadata from TypeScript class declarations
Analyze class members including methods, properties, and accessors
Evaluate class heritage and generic parameters
Determine visibility modifiers and static status for class elements
Parse constructor signatures and parameter-defined properties
relationships: The class analyzer coordinates the analysis of individual members like methods and properties to build a complete class representation.
Member analyzers utilize visibility utility functions to determine the access control status of properties and methods.
Constructor analysis integrates with member analysis to identify properties implicitly defined through constructor parameters.
designDecisions: Modular analysis strategy where each class component has a dedicated processing function
Functional composition of analysis logic to extract metadata incrementally
Stateless extraction of AST node properties into structured metadata formats
